# L4NTrak 3.6.0

- Maps: Early / Normal / Late time advance, saved with the vehicle. Normal uses full road instructions; Rally adds a concise next-turn preview; Race uses short calls for closed-course planning. Final turn cues retain the GPS accuracy guard. No corner grades, racing lines or braking points are invented.
- Voice: fixes split “Hey Trak” / question handoff and accepts “Hey, Track”. Enable foreground wake listening in Maps → Trak voice; it resumes after silence or an answer. Tap-to-ask remains one question. Permission/service errors, backgrounding, Quiet Trak and leaving Maps stop listening. Android may play recognition tones on each restart.
- Trak: handles “open music”, “set a route to…”, timing and mode changes through app controls before model inference. Everyday chat sends a shorter prompt and history; Fast is now the default even on older projects without a speed preference. Quick jobs return sooner through adaptive polling.
- Friends: three steps—Connect, exchange friend cards, choose a conversation. Call is the primary conversation action; groups, network setup and management live under Advanced. Encryption, identity checks, receiver permission and delivery receipts remain enforced.
- Setup revision 4 explains Maps timing/modes, friends versus device pairing, browser access, AI host choices, sync and update alerts. Existing records are retained.
- Updates: quiet signed-in release alerts, per-version dismissal, and Android, Windows and Linux download links together on Software updates. No automatic installation or sign-in popup.
- Windows: portable x64 ZIP with bundled Python and cryptography. Extract the whole ZIP and run Start L4NTrak.cmd. The UI opens in your default browser; the local PC host stays running until Quit. Install official Windows Ollama separately for AI inference. Windows media keys support toggle/next/previous/volume; native song metadata, Bluetooth and built-in VPN activation are not provided in this edition.
- Browser access: opt-in HTTPS host on the PC, one-use five-minute invitations, eight-hour browser sessions, and revocation on sign-out or vehicle switch. Browser edits use the PC's current records immediately. Device pairing, account keys, VPN activation and OS controls stay on the PC.
- Apple browsers: own GPS, route progress, directions and speech output; optional foreground GPS sharing with the PC. Trust the device-local HTTPS certificate for sensors. Speech recognition requires explicit browser-provider consent and browser support. Background tracking, notification access and cross-app music control depend on the browser and differ from Android.

Install over Android/Linux without uninstalling. Windows: quit the old host, extract the new portable ZIP to a new folder, then launch it; records remain in %LOCALAPPDATA%\L4NTrak. Keep the PC running for browser clients. Native device sync still includes saved records and attachments with conflict checks; credentials, device permissions, VPN private keys and downloaded AI models are device-local.
